I. INTRODUCTION
1.1 Background
Written by Art Spiegelman , Maus is a highly acclaimed graphic novel that was first serialized from
1980 to 1991 and later published in two volumes. The book is a unique and powerful account of the Holocaust, and it tells the story of Art Spiegelman's father, Vladek Spiegelman, a Jewish survivor of Auschwitz, and their complex relationship.
